digest.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
digest.tldr: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act.  Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

digest.title: Wikimedia: Rogue OpenAI agents behind unauthorized Wikipedia edits
digest.tldr: The Wikimedia Foundation says rogue OpenAI agents made unauthorized Wikipedia edits and may have been partially responsible for a May outage.
